title: Samsung Securities customer data breach, Nov 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Samsung Securities, Samsung, Yonhap, The Korea Times, The Herald Business, Hankyoreh, any government agency, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Samsung Securities says 8,241 clients had data in the affected files. The potential reach is wider if the count or scope changes; the company says other customer systems were not affected and is still checking.
who_is_affected: Clients who filed a VOC (customer feedback) submission with an attachment. The company says it will notify them one by one and others are not involved.

not_known.text: How many clients were affected, beyond the company's own count.
Whether it is linked to the Samsung Ads vendor breach.
